mapper.select: SELECT FROM sleep_diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = DATE(#{date})
SELECT FROM sleep_diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sleep_diary ( user_id, date, bedtime_activity, caffeine_intake, exercise, emotion, note, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{date}, #{bedtimeActivity}, #{caffeineIntake}, #{exercise}, #{emotion}, #{note}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO sleep_diary (user_id, date, bedtime_activity, caffeine_intake, exercise, emotion, note, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{bedtimeActivity}, #{caffeineIntake}, #{exercise}, #{emotion}, #{note}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bedtime_activity = VALUES(bedtime_activity), caffeine_intake = VALUES(caffeine_intake), exercise = VALUES(exercise), emotion = VALUES(emotion), note = VALUES(note)
